test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A company offers a scheme discount of 'buy 5 get 3 free' offer on shirts. Find the discount percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount percentage in **Buy X Get Y Free** schemes is calculated as (Free quantity ÷ Total quantity) × 100.

Free quantity = 3 shirts.

Total quantity (Paid + Free) = 5 + 3 = 8 shirts.

Discount% = (3 ÷ 8) × 100 = 37.5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 37.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Buy 5 Get 3 Free** offer.

Formulas: Discount% = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100 | MP = Price of all items including free ones.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58eed9016c83e52fe7101e17a01cb762a235ac02e9eb940ba70d8c4e7834477c.png] 

⇒ Let the **Marked Price (MP)** of 1 shirt be 1 unit.

⇒ Total MP of 8 shirts (5 bought + 3 free) = 8 units.

⇒ The customer gets 3 shirts for free, so **Discount** = 3 units.

⇒ Discount% = (3 ÷ 8) × 100.

⇒ Discount% = 37.5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 37.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

The **Marked Price** is the price printed on the label. **Discount** is always calculated on the MP unless stated otherwise.

Successive Discounts

If a scheme offers **Buy X Get Y Free** plus an additional Z% discount, calculate the first discount% then apply the second one using the successive formula: a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100.</p
